Create the wagmi submission boundary for each reviewed Relayr transaction.
Submit the exact target, calldata, and value after switching to its declared chain.
Create the wagmi EIP-712 signing boundary for a canonical ERC-2771 forward request.
Sign only the validated chain, canonical forwarder domain, nonce, request, and deadline.

Read only eth_call on a PublicClient with explicit Safe selectors, gas and response bounds, at latest or a caller-given block (the reviewed receipt block when verifying). Serves Safe deployment verification and the authority identity, nonce and approval reads. Never sign, send, or follow OffchainLookup URLs.
Read only a raw eth_call of the reviewed call, bounded by explicit gas and a return data limit, at latest or a caller-given block. Never sign, send, or follow OffchainLookup URLs.
